HELLOSPIRE-THE_GUNSLINGER.title: The Gunslinger
HELLOSPIRE-THE_GUNSLINGER.description: [gold]Six Chambers[/gold]: A weathered shooter off an endless road. Loads the cylinder, counts what is coming, and decides whether this is a turn for cover or for everything at once.
HELLOSPIRE-THE_GUNSLINGER.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough for ammunition. The rest is weight.[/sine]
HELLOSPIRE-THE_GUNSLINGER.eventDeathPrev: One chamber left. There is always one chamber left.
HELLOSPIRE-THE_GUNSLINGER.cardsModifierD: Gunslinger cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
